subject: Re: Head Chef Position at Restaurant Noma
body: I am writing to express my interest in the Head Chef position at Restaurant Noma. With 11 years of experience across Michelin-starred kitchens and a deep focus on Nordic fermentation, I am confident I can contribute to your brigade's continued excellence.

In my most recent role as Chef de Cuisine at Noma, I ran the game and forest menu seasons, serving 40 covers nightly across 12 courses. I built a fermentation lab producing 60+ in-house garums, kojis, and vinegars, cutting external supplier costs by $80k per year. Previously, as Sous Chef at The French Laundry, I supervised 12 cooks across garde manger and saucier stations during three consecutive Michelin three-star reviews.

My culinary philosophy centers on zero-waste menu design and scaling fermentation techniques for high-volume kitchens. I have presented these approaches at the Nordic Food Tech Conference and led workshops at the Copenhagen Culinary Institute on utilizing 100% of ingredient byproducts through fermentation and preservation.
I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background in Nordic cuisine, fermentation innovation, and brigade leadership aligns with Noma's vision. Thank you for your time and consideration.
